response.justification: While Bogdan has 20+ years of software development experience and strong progression to senior/staff level, there is a critical mismatch: the role requires deep C++ systems programming expertise, but his last significant C++ work was 10+ years ago (6 months at National Instruments in 2014-2015). His career has pivoted heavily toward web/backend development using TypeScript and Node.js in recent years. Additionally, he lacks demonstrated expertise in the required security domains (SDL, IEC 62443) and industrial automation knowledge (protocols, IoT systems, industrial cybersecurity). The technical gap is too significant for a role centered on C++ systems design.
strengths: 20+ years of software development experience with demonstrated progression to staff/senior level, exceeding the 8-12 year requirement
Strong architectural thinking with proven experience building distributed, event-driven, and microservices-based systems that could transfer to systems design
Excellent mentoring and knowledge-sharing capabilities, evidenced by workshops, talks, and active contribution to open-source projects
concerns: Minimal and outdated C++ experience (6 months in 2014-2015); career trajectory shows clear shift away from systems programming toward TypeScript/Node.js web development over the past 8+ years
No demonstrated expertise in security domains critical to the role (Secure Development Lifecycle, IEC 62443, industrial cybersecurity standards, secure coding practices)
Absence of industrial automation, IoT, or industrial protocol domain knowledge (Modbus TCP/IP, IEC 61850, IEC 104, DNP 3.0, OPC UA); experience is exclusively in web and cloud platforms
